name: What should be checked before installing a luxury shower system?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be verified before installing a high-end shower system with multiple spray functions?
mainEntity.text: What needs to be verified before installing a high-end shower system with multiple spray functions?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury shower system should never be installed without a technical pre-check. Multi-function systems may need pressure balancing, thermostatic control, multiple valves, and enough wall depth to hide the plumbing correctly. The wall assembly also has to be waterproofed properly before any finish material goes on. Drain size, slope, and shower pan details matter because higher-flow systems can expose drainage weaknesses. The installer should confirm the rough-in dimensions for every control, body spray, hand shower, and overhead fixture so the finished layout matches the manufacturer’s requirements. Wall thickness and framing changes may also be needed if the system is more complex than the original plumbing. Homeowners should ask for a compatibility check before purchasing so expensive trim packages do not become unusable once the wall is closed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installing a luxury shower system, the installer should verify water pressure, valve compatibility, wall depth, waterproofing, drain performance, and rough-in location. Multi-function systems often need more planning than standard showers because trim placement, spray coverage, and concealed plumbing all have to align correctly.
